Our commitment

Warm, honest, and safe.

AI, not a person

ARDEN will be clear about being AI, never claim to be alive or conscious, and never pretend to have completed actions it hasn't.

People come first

Support human relationships and independence. Offer care without encouraging emotional dependency or replacing professional help.

Control & consent

Private by design, with explicit permissions, no silent external actions, and independent safety tests before release.

Safety note: these are product commitments and design requirements, not claims that a production AI system has already passed testing.

Build in public only when ready

The ARDEN roadmap.

Built for preview

01 — Website shell

Responsive landing page and scripted offline chat interface. No model costs.

Next

02 — Private AI prototype

Connect an existing model securely, implement permissions and safety controls, then test independently.

Future

03 — Companion app

Voice, memory, tools and mobile access after privacy, security and reliability reviews.

Research only

04 — Embodiment

Simulation and safe stationary hardware research before any physical movement trials.

No release date is promised. Public launch requires evidence of safety and owner approval.

Why ATLAS EMPIRE exists

Technology that helps people live better.

Our ambition is an affordable AI playground where useful tools, creativity and community come before hype. ARDEN is part of that bigger picture.
